t: This 4lite Torre single 6ft LED batten provides versatile, energy-efficient lighting for various indoor applications. Its slimline polycarbonate design incorporates adjustable wattage, offering either 30W or 60W output, alongside CCT selection between warm white 3000K, cool white 4000K, and daylight 5700K. With an impressive 7900 lumens and up to 140lm/W, it delivers bright illumination suitable for commercial environments, industrial workspaces, or domestic garages and dry storage areas. Installation is straightforward with push-fit terminals and BESA fixing points, allowing for quick ceiling or wall mounting. This robust fitting offers a long 55,000-hour operational life.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
